plan.title: P3-U1a: revert release checks that contradict the #5947 decision (U1a: code removal, release finish step, release skill)

narratives.Description: OVPR fix plan unit P3-U1a (story id ovpr-p3-u1a), Fix steps 1-3 of units/P3-U1-version-bump-is-just-a-bump.md. Remove the #6184 product code, rewrite `release:local-update` to pull, install, confirm installed = pin, and rewrite release skill Phase 7 step 8 to match. Part B of #6613 (fixture steps, #5952 text) is P3-U1b and gets its own brief; it is out of scope here.
narratives.Overview:
Acceptance criteria (P3-U1a, Part A of #6613):
1. `git grep -n -E 'validateCursorDepositAssociation|stageTipRequiredCursorDeposit|preparePinCandidateCursorDeposit|tipRequiredCursorDepositPaths|defaultGitAddForce'` returns nothing in `packages/` or `Taskfile.yml`.
2. `hostHookOuterSha8()` is unchanged (a test compares it with the value on master).
3. `release:local-update` contains no `verify:hooks-installed`, no `DEFT_DOCTOR_HOOK_DIAGNOSTIC`, no `directive upgrade`, and no failure on tracked-file changes after install.
4. On a checkout where pin and installed are both V, `task release:local-update -- V --checkout <primary>` exits 0 after pull and install, even when committed hook files are older than V.
5. Release skill Phase 7 step 8 lists exactly: checkout checks, pull, install, confirm installed = pin; and says a later upgrade diff is normal.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Remove the #6184 code. host-hook-outer.ts: header comment, the execFileSync import (if no other use), CURSOR_HOOKS_JSON_REL, tipRequiredCursorDepositPaths, the CursorDeposit* types, defaultReadTreeFile, hooksJsonRegistersOuter, defaultGitAddForce, stageTipRequiredCursorDeposit, validateCursorDepositAssociation. agent-hooks.ts: the #6184 imports, the wrapper, the re-exports, preparePinCandidateCursorDeposit and resolveCursorDepositAssociationForCloseout; keep HOST_HOOK_MISSING_PIN_PROJECT_PM_GUIDANCE and the other existing exports. Delete the #6184 tests in host-hook-outer.test.ts and agent-hooks.test.ts. Add a test that hostHookOuterSha8() is unchanged.
2. Rewrite `release:local-update` (Taskfile.yml): argument and checkout checks -> default branch + `git pull --ff-only` -> `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` -> confirm package.json pin == installed == <version> -> print: `release:local-update COMPLETE; checkout=<path> version=<V>. Hook files refresh on the next hook run (AC8.6). Run 'directive upgrade' and commit when you choose.` Remove print_deposit_recovery, check A, check B, the AgeExclude check (D-006), the dirty-tree refusal (D-006), the `directive upgrade` call, the post-upgrade diff failure, the final verify:hooks-installed and the second version check. Keep 'never reset, force-push, commit or npm i -g'. Renew the xbrief/evaluator-surface-disposition.json disclosure the normal way.
3. Rewrite release skill Phase 7 step 8 (content/skills/deft-directive-release/SKILL.md) to the same steps. Remove sub-steps 6, 8 and 9, the 'deposit-merge recovery' wording in Skill Completion, the deposit clauses in the anti-patterns, and the 'Prefer-A Bound' labels. Add: 'A post-release `directive upgrade` that changes hook files is normal. Commit it in an ordinary PR when you choose. It is not part of the release.' Fold in #6358's release half (D-017, O-40): one line naming the pin-bump PR step (package.json pin, AgeExclude row, lockfile, one changelog line) before release:local-update, and printing `npm i -g @deftai/directive@<version>` when the global launcher is behind. Regenerate content/packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json and docs/RULE-MAP.md with the repo's generators.
4. Changelog fragment changelog.d/6613-release-finish-pull-install-confirm.md (never CHANGELOG.md).
narratives.Constraint:
Must not do:
- Do not change AC14.10, AC8.6 or AC9.10 text.
- Do not add any check that needs refreshed hook files on master before a release can finish, in any form.
- Do not move refresh work into CI, and do not make a pin-bump PR carry hook files.
- Do not run `npm i -g` from the release step (#3753).
- Do not touch hostHookOuterSource() (the .mjs bytes); that would churn every consumer's sha8. #6166 / #6167 own outer-byte changes.
- Do not implement #6358 item 1 (session start runs the install); declined by D-017.
- Do not edit verify:evaluator-surface or other gates to make the PR green (gate integrity, #3156).
- Do not edit .github/dependabot.yml (D-028 dropped the Dependabot step).
- Do not do Part B (fixture steps 1-3, #5952 text); that is P3-U1b.
- OVPR change gate: do not edit docs/installer-refactor-ovpr/ or ship behaviour that departs from the written OVPR design; stop and hand back a change proposal if needed.

Given the PR, when a test compares hostHookOuterSha8() with the value on master, then they are equal.

sentences: Revert release checks that contradict the #5947 decision
Problem After each Directive release, the maintainer runs a finish step, `task release:local-update`, that updates their own checkout to the new version.
That step now refuses to finish unless the refreshed hook files were already committed to `master` with the version bump.
When it refuses, it prints instructions: repair, force-add the hook files past the ignore rules, open a second PR, then run the step again.
Only an agent can follow those instructions.
An ordinary repository has no agent in CI: Dependabot bumps the version, CI installs it, and nobody reads Directive's output.
polfer decided on 2026-11-09/10 (#5947) that a bump which changes only the version is complete.
Hook files refresh on the developer's machine the first time a hook runs, and a person runs `directive upgrade` and commits when they choose.
The finish step contradicts that decision.
It also ships about 190 lines of code to every customer that only this one release step uses.
Evidence (origin/master `def527f5e`): - #6127 (for #5953, merged 2026-11-09 01:52Z, before the #5947 seal) added `release:local-update` and its release-skill text.
#6184 (for #6163, merged 2026-11-11, after the decision file; released in 0.129.7) added check B and its product code.
`Taskfile.yml` `release:local-update` (`:861` onward): - `print_deposit_recovery` (`:956-962`): "force-add tip-required Cursor paths … merge that pin+deposit tip, then re-run".
dirty-tree refusal (`:1019-1023`); AgeExclude check on `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (`:1044-1091`).
pull, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and the pin = installed check (`:1042`, `:1092-1100`).
These stay.
Check A (#6127): `DEFT_DOCTOR_HOOK_DIAGNOSTIC=1 … verify:hooks-installed --scope=agent` (`:1106-1111`).
The env var turns automatic setup off, so it sees only what is committed.
Check B (#6184): imports `validateCursorDepositAssociation` from the installed runtime and requires the new-hash Cursor files in `HEAD` (`:1112-1143`).
`directive upgrade`, then post-upgrade diff = failure (`:1145-1162`), then a final `verify:hooks-installed --scope=all` and a second version check (`:1163-1171`).

#6184 product code: `packages/core/src/init-deposit/host-hook-outer.ts` (`execFileSync` import `:17`, `CURSOR_HOOKS_JSON_REL` `:30`, `tipRequiredCursorDepositPaths` `:75`, `defaultGitAddForce` `:159` which runs `git add -f`, `stageTipRequiredCursorDeposit` `:172`, `validateCursorDepositAssociation` `:190`) and `packages/core/src/init-deposit/agent-hooks.ts` (wrapper `:35`, `preparePinCandidateCursorDeposit` `:693` with no production caller, `resolveCursorDepositAssociationForCloseout` `:727`).
None of it is inside `hostHookOuterSource()`, so removing it does not change the deposited `.mjs` bytes or their sha8.

Release skill `content/skills/deft-directive-release/SKILL.md`, Phase 7 step 8 (`:411-426`): sub-step 6 ("Keep Phase 7 local closeout incomplete until that deposit evidence exists"), sub-step 8 (post-upgrade tracked diff = incomplete), sub-step 9; Skill Completion (`:470`); anti-patterns (`:478`).
What the design says - AC14.10: Dependabot changed only pin + lockfile to W; the first registered hook or eligible command completes wiring at W, then proceeds.
AC8.6: automatic setup on the first eligible hook or command; no lifecycle script is required.
AC9.10 / AC12.1: doctor and its probes never write.
LLM-CONTEXT §4 and §6 item 6: do not redefine "a pin bump PR must also deposit/refresh all wiring"; epic exit criteria that contradict AC14.10 lose.

Decision `xbrief/decisions/2026-11-10-close-5947-5948-via-ac14-10-proof-process-note-pin-only-dependab.decision.json`: pin-only/Dependabot OK; the rejected alternative is "Require deposit refresh in every pin/Dependabot PR".

clauses.text: Revert release checks that contradict the #5947 decision
Problem After each Directive release, the maintainer runs a finish step, `task release:local-update`, that updates their own checkout to the new version.
That step now refuses to finish unless the refreshed hook files were already committed to `master` with the version bump.
When it refuses, it prints instructions: repair, force-add the hook files past the ignore rules, open a second PR, then run the step again.
Only an agent can follow those instructions.
An ordinary repository has no agent in CI: Dependabot bumps the version, CI installs it, and nobody reads Directive's output.
polfer decided on 2026-11-09/10 (#5947) that a bump which changes only the version is complete.
Hook files refresh on the developer's machine the first time a hook runs, and a person runs `directive upgrade` and commits when they choose.
The finish step contradicts that decision.
It also ships about 190 lines of code to every customer that only this one release step uses.
Evidence (origin/master `def527f5e`): - #6127 (for #5953, merged 2026-11-09 01:52Z, before the #5947 seal) added `release:local-update` and its release-skill text.
#6184 (for #6163, merged 2026-11-11, after the decision file; released in 0.129.7) added check B and its product code.
`Taskfile.yml` `release:local-update` (`:861` onward): - `print_deposit_recovery` (`:956-962`): "force-add tip-required Cursor paths … merge that pin+deposit tip, then re-run".
dirty-tree refusal (`:1019-1023`); AgeExclude check on `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (`:1044-1091`).
pull, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and the pin = installed check (`:1042`, `:1092-1100`).
These stay.
Check A (#6127): `DEFT_DOCTOR_HOOK_DIAGNOSTIC=1 … verify:hooks-installed --scope=agent` (`:1106-1111`).
The env var turns automatic setup off, so it sees only what is committed.
Check B (#6184): imports `validateCursorDepositAssociation` from the installed runtime and requires the new-hash Cursor files in `HEAD` (`:1112-1143`).
`directive upgrade`, then post-upgrade diff = failure (`:1145-1162`), then a final `verify:hooks-installed --scope=all` and a second version check (`:1163-1171`).

#6184 product code: `packages/core/src/init-deposit/host-hook-outer.ts` (`execFileSync` import `:17`, `CURSOR_HOOKS_JSON_REL` `:30`, `tipRequiredCursorDepositPaths` `:75`, `defaultGitAddForce` `:159` which runs `git add -f`, `stageTipRequiredCursorDeposit` `:172`, `validateCursorDepositAssociation` `:190`) and `packages/core/src/init-deposit/agent-hooks.ts` (wrapper `:35`, `preparePinCandidateCursorDeposit` `:693` with no production caller, `resolveCursorDepositAssociationForCloseout` `:727`).
None of it is inside `hostHookOuterSource()`, so removing it does not change the deposited `.mjs` bytes or their sha8.

Release skill `content/skills/deft-directive-release/SKILL.md`, Phase 7 step 8 (`:411-426`): sub-step 6 ("Keep Phase 7 local closeout incomplete until that deposit evidence exists"), sub-step 8 (post-upgrade tracked diff = incomplete), sub-step 9; Skill Completion (`:470`); anti-patterns (`:478`).
What the design says - AC14.10: Dependabot changed only pin + lockfile to W; the first registered hook or eligible command completes wiring at W, then proceeds.
AC8.6: automatic setup on the first eligible hook or command; no lifecycle script is required.
AC9.10 / AC12.1: doctor and its probes never write.
LLM-CONTEXT §4 and §6 item 6: do not redefine "a pin bump PR must also deposit/refresh all wiring"; epic exit criteria that contradict AC14.10 lose.

Decision `xbrief/decisions/2026-11-10-close-5947-5948-via-ac14-10-proof-process-note-pin-only-dependab.decision.json`: pin-only/Dependabot OK; the rejected alternative is "Require deposit refresh in every pin/Dependabot PR".

polfer on #5947 (2026-11-09): "Do not redefine pin-bump done as deposit-in-same-PR." On #5948: "Doctor dirty before eligible auto-setup is expected." On #5952: epic exit criteria must not require "deposit in the same pin PR".
D-001 (Rule 1): remove check A, check B, the skill rule that treats a post-upgrade diff as failure, and the #6184 code.
The finish step becomes pull, install, confirm installed = pin.
D-004: split into P3-U1a (Phase 0) and P3-U1b (Phase 3).
D-006: also drop the dirty-tree refusal and the AgeExclude check.
D-017 (O-40): fold #6358's release half into P3-U1a; decline its session-start half.
D-028: no Dependabot change in this repo.
`.github/dependabot.yml` stays as it is.

Remove the #6184 code from `host-hook-outer.ts` and `agent-hooks.ts` (the functions and imports listed above, and their re-exports).
Keep `HOST_HOOK_MISSING_PIN_PROJECT_PM_GUIDANCE` and the other existing exports.
Delete the #6184 tests in `host-hook-outer.test.ts` and `agent-hooks.test.ts`.

Rewrite `release:local-update` to: argument and checkout checks → `git pull --ff-only` on the default branch → `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` → confirm `package.json` pin = installed = `<version>` → one line: `release:local-update COMPLETE; checkout=<path> version=<V>.
Hook files refresh on the next hook run (AC8.6).

Run 'directive upgrade' and commit when you choose.` Remove `print_deposit_recovery`, check A, check B, the AgeExclude check, the dirty-tree refusal, the `directive upgrade` call, the post-upgrade diff failure, the final `verify:hooks-installed` and the second version check.
Keep "never reset, force-push, commit or `npm i -g`".
Renew the `xbrief/evaluator-surface-disposition.json` disclosure the normal way; don't edit the gate.

Regenerate `content/packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json` and `docs/RULE-MAP.md` with the repo's generators.

Change only the `@deftai/directive-runtime` pin and lockfile in the fixture from V to W.
Run the project install, with no agent and no Directive command.
